column2: aptus Philippines brief target 6 — Philippine org-structure sample values
EMPTY, AND THE EMPTINESS IS THE FINDING. Zero data rows.

the workbook is country-INDEPENDENT by construction and publishes no Philippine values. Its own first row says "## represents the two-digit country code" — country-specific ids are written as templates, not as values — and its legend reads "(XX) --> Global (country-independent)". The sample values it does publish (company code 1000/2000, plant 1000/1100, purchasing org 1000/2000, sales org 1000/1100 and so on) are the global Best Practices values. The strings "PH", "5810", "MY" and "5410" do not occur anywhere in either sheet.

this answers the brief's question rather than filling its file. SapOrgStructureElement's 116 rows cannot be Malaysian values from this workbook, because this workbook has none — they are the GLOBAL sample values. The missing country column is therefore not a Malaysia/Philippines problem; it is that the rows are country-independent and are currently implied to be country-specific. The fix is to stamp them XX, not to harvest a PH set.

the Philippine company code SAP predelivers is 5810 — published in BP_CLD_ENTPR_2608_Account_Master_Data_for_YCOA.xlsx as the column header "PH (5810)". A Philippine organisational-structure workbook, if SAP publishes one, sits in the Best Practices content library behind a signed-in session, which this run did not have.

the brief says to read each column down independently and never to read across a row to assert a parent-child relationship the workbook does not state. No relationship was asserted: no rows were emitted.
